_comment: Real-world NFL stat correlation targets, measured from nflverse-data (github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data: player_stats, stats_team, schedules releases), 2021-2025 regular seasons. Not consumed by any code yet -- a diagnosis-task deliverable (measurement only, no sim changes) for comparing against engine/sim/draws.ts's realized correlations. DraftKings Classic (full-PPR) fantasy points computed from raw counting stats, not nflverse's own fantasy_points_ppr column (which uses a different -2 INT / -2 fumble-lost / no-yardage-bonus formula). Roles ranked per team per week: QB1 by attempts, RB1 by carries, WR1/WR2 by targets (top 2), TE1 by targets, DST = that team's own defense/special-teams scoring (sacks, interceptions, fumble recoveries off the opponent, defensive + special-teams TDs, safeties, blocked kicks, tiered points-allowed bonus -- opponent's score in that game, via schedules' home_score/away_score). Opponent pairs join same-game rows on game_id. sim_r is engine/sim/draws.ts's drawSlateOutcomes realized Pearson r, measured on data/samples/DraftKings NFL DFS Projections -- Main Slate (6).csv (20,000 trials, all 20 teams pooled, roles by salary rank within each team).
